raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the English king who "trusted William de Longchamp" as King Richard I. William de Longchamp was the regent for King John (Richard I's brother) during the period of the Third Crusade (1190-1191), not Richard I. Richard I was the one leading the fleet that was dispersed by the storm in 1191, but he did not trust Longchamp; Longchamp was the regent acting in Richard's absence. This fundamental historical error in identifying the king led the entire conversation to focus on the wrong monarch's relationship with Longchamp, although the subsequent search for the storm date (1191) coincidentally aligned with the correct event (Richard's fleet dispersal), the reasoning regarding the "king who trusted Longchamp" was flawed from the start.
